name: SIGMA - LSASS Memory Dump via comsvcs.dll MiniDump
description:
Detects rundll32.exe calling the MiniDump export of comsvcs.dll (by name or by its
ordinal #24). This is a well-known "living off the land" way to write a full memory
dump of a process - in practice almost always lsass.exe - so that credentials can be
extracted offline with tools such as Mimikatz or pypykatz. It complements the
process-access rule because it fires on the command line even if Sysmon event ID 10
is not collected.

query_string.query: data.win.system.eventID:1 AND ((data.win.eventdata.image:*\\rundll32.exe OR data.win.eventdata.originalFileName:RUNDLL32.EXE) AND data.win.eventdata.commandLine:*comsvcs* AND (data.win.eventdata.commandLine:(*MiniDump* OR *#24* OR *#\+24*)))
